{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where price bottoms before forecast bottoms",
    "Sentiment acceleration (0→1) correlates with faster price recovery in forecasts than reality",
    "When price is in a downtream, model-mean-reversion causes forecasts to undershoot actual price bottoms",
    "Sentiment turning positive (1.00) precedes price stabilization in both forecasts and reality",
    "Model uses historical mean reversion which doesn't account for structural price levels in uptrends",
    "Sentiment deceleration (1→0.67→0.33→0) in reality occurs more abruptly than in forecasts",
    "When price has been rising, model's mean-reversion to historical averages creates systematic undershoot of current price levels"
] }
